A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Make it clear.
Make it usable.

I’m Darrell Rodriguez, a UX designer with a Bachelor of Science in Graphic Information Technology with a UX focus from Arizona State University, earned in May 2025.

I’m pursuing an M.S. in Graphic Information Technology at ASU, with graduation expected in May 2027. My goal is to design and build digital products that are easy to understand, easy to navigate, and useful in everyday life.

My work includes mapping user flows, building Figma prototypes, reviewing accessibility, and developing websites with HTML and CSS. I use these skills to turn complex tasks into experiences people can understand and use with confidence.
